name: Else
tagline: AI assistant for research, files and multi-step work
description:
Else is a web-based AI assistant that can research the web, analyze files and produce deliverables in response to a task. It is intended for individuals and small teams who want help with work such as preparing a research brief or turning a spreadsheet into a report. Users should review important results and verify sources before relying on them.

The service uses a prepaid balance rather than a monthly subscription. New accounts start with a limited free balance without a card. After that, users can top up; task costs vary with the tier and resources consumed, and receipts itemize the work performed. Limits are checked after a billed step and can be exceeded by that step.

Else can work on multi-step and recurring tasks; availability of features and integrations can change. See the official pricing page and documentation for current details.
